payload.text: Please code this website for me. Build a modern, professional, high-conversion e-commerce website for "Agro Farm Machineries and Supplies" – a leading supplier of agricultural machinery based in Nakuru, Kenya (shop near Pivot Hotel in the industrial area). Business details: - We sell affordable, high-quality farm machines for Kenyan smallholder farmers and agribusinesses: posho mills / roller mills / disc mills (electric & diesel), chaff cutters, choppermills, feed mixers & crushers, maize shellers & hullers, silage blowers, sprayers, block-making machines, and more. - Prices range from KSh 45,000 to KSh 500,000. - Services: Nationwide delivery across Kenya + professional installation + pay-on-delivery option. - Contact: WhatsApp & Call +254 718 981 630. Location: Nakuru Industrial Area near Pivot Hotel. - Social: TikTok @agrofarmmachineries, Facebook @agromachinerieskenya – we have lots of short demo videos. Target audience: Kenyan farmers, dairy farmers, and people starting posho mill or animal feed businesses. Tone: Reliable, helpful, expert, farmer-friendly, trustworthy. Empower them to increase productivity. Design style: Clean modern agricultural theme. Primary colors: forest green (#228B22), earthy brown/tan, cream/white background, bright orange accents for CTAs. Sans-serif fonts (clean and readable). High-quality images of happy Kenyan farmers using the machines, green fields, and close-up machine photos. Mobile-first, super fast loading, fully responsive. Key pages & sections: - Home: Big hero video or slider with machinery in action + headline “Quality Farm Machines for Kenyan Farmers – Delivered & Installed” + prominent “Shop Now” and WhatsApp buttons. - Shop / All Products: Grid with filters (Category: Posho Mills, Fodder Choppers & Feed Processors, Construction & Sprayers; Price range; Power source: Electric/Diesel/Petrol). “Load more” and search bar. - Product detail pages: Large images + embedded TikTok demo video + full specifications table + price + “Inquire on WhatsApp” + “Call Now” buttons + “Customers also bought” + related products. - Categories pages for main groups. - About Us: Our story, why choose us (quality guarantee, local support in Nakuru, nationwide delivery & installation, pay on delivery). - Services / Delivery: Clear info on pay-on-delivery, installation, coverage map of Kenya. - Testimonials: Real-looking customer stories and delivery photos/videos. - Contact: Google map embed to Nakuru shop, phone/WhatsApp buttons, contact form. - Blog (optional starter posts): “How to Choose the Right Posho Mill”, “Tips for Dairy Feed Production in Kenya”, etc. for SEO. Must-have features: - Floating green WhatsApp chat button (prominent on every page) - Strong emphasis on “Pay on Delivery + Installation” trust badges - SEO optimized: page titles and meta with keywords like “posho mill Nakuru”, “buy chaff cutter Kenya”, “roller mill for sale Kenya” - Easy to add real product images, prices, and TikTok links later - Fast performance and beautiful animations Generate the full website structure with realistic placeholder content, images, and videos that I can easily replace. Make it ready for export or direct publishing. Focus on high conversion and building trust for high-ticket agricultural equipment sales in Kenya.

**Defining the Project Scope**

I'm now zeroing in on defining the project scope, prioritizing user needs for a high-converting e-commerce site for agricultural machinery. I'm focusing on "Agro Farm Machineries and Supplies" to ensure this project focuses on the user's explicit goal. The priority is to develop an understanding of the user's business requirements, and how the requirements interact to deliver value to customers. I'm working on a plan to determine the ideal features needed for success.


**Refining the Target Audience**

I've specified the target audience as Kenyan farmers and agribusiness owners, and I'm developing a visual identity, selecting reliable tones and a focused color palette. My design will use forest green, earthy brown, cream, white, and orange for CTAs. I'm choosing a modern tech stack, React with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React icons, and React Router.

\
**Structuring the Project**

I'm now structuring the project for a mobile-first e-commerce platform. I'm focusing on "Agro Farm Machineries and Supplies" to ensure this project focuses on the user's explicit goal. I'm defining core components (Header, Footer, ProductCard), pages (Home, Shop, Services, Contact), and types with TypeScript definitions. A `metadata.json` will hold app details.


**Listing Core Features**

I'm presently focused on detailing the critical features for the e-commerce platform. I've broken down the essential components, like navigation (sticky header with search and categories), the home page (hero, value props, best sellers), and the shop page (product grid with filters). I'm also planning the product page (detailed specs, WhatsApp integration), services page (delivery map), and the contact/about section (map, form). I plan to include a persistent floating WhatsApp CTA for easy communication. I'm actively drafting the content.


**Building the Application**

I'm now in the thick of application development. I've set up the foundational types and constants, defining the `Product` interface and creating mock data for Kenyan machinery items. I'm focusing on Placeholder images with descriptions. Next, I am building the core components, starting with a professional-looking `Header.tsx`, a functional `Footer.tsx`, and a pulsing WhatsApp button for easy customer interaction. Finally, the foundational `ProductCard.tsx` is underway, laying the groundwork for the shop. I am preparing to implement the landing page.


**Implementing the Navigation**

I'm now implementing the navigation structure, designing a categories grid and a featured products section for the landing page. I've simplified the shop page with a dropdown filter and grid of products. Product details now include a big image, specs table, "Order via WhatsApp", and "Call Now" buttons. I've drafted the services section to describe "Pay on Delivery". I'm starting to build the application and defining routes using HashRouter for this environment.


**Enhancing the User Experience**

I'm currently focused on refining the visual design using Tailwind CSS. I'm implementing brand color specifications, like green-700 for the primary color, and orange-500 for call-to-action buttons. I am applying mobile-responsive padding and margins. I've also added hover effects to create a premium feel. I am checking for proper wording and imagery, and SEO tweaks to improve the site.

Here is the complete code for the "Agro Farm Machineries" e-commerce application.

This solution is built with **React**, **TypeScript**, and **Tailwind CSS**. It features a mobile-first design, high-conversion elements (WhatsApp integration, trust badges), and a structure optimized for the Kenyan agricultural market.
